skills.name: wind-ui
skills.description: Style Flutter UI with wind_kit: Tailwind-syntax className, W-widgets, dark: pairs, stacked prefixes, WindRecipe and WDynamic.

skills.name: magic-framework
skills.description: Write correct, idiomatic code in a Flutter app that depends on the `magic` framework (Laravel-inspired: IoC container, 13 facades, Eloquent-style ORM, service providers, reactive controllers, GoRouter routing, validation, auth, MagicAction writes, Repository row caches, SessionScope tenant resets). Use whenever code imports `package:magic/magic.dart` or `package:magic/testing.dart`, or the work touches Magic.init, MagicApp, a facade (Auth/Http/Cache/Event/Gate/Config/Lang/Launch/Log/MagicRoute/Session/Storage/Vault), a Model, MagicController, a MagicView, MagicFormData, FormRequest, MagicAction, MagicFormObject, Repository, SessionScope, a ServiceProvider, or the magic:dowel make:* CLI. The SQLite, encryption, picker and broadcasting layers are plugins (magic_local_storage, magic_encryption, magic_picker, magic_socket). UI styling is Wind (separate wind-ui skill). Do NOT use for plain Flutter or Wind-only work with no magic import.
